1.translation: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, “Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment.”

2.translation: He said: “O my people, indeed I am a clear warner to you,

3.translation: that you worship Allah and fear Him, and obey me;

4.translation: He will forgive you some of your sins and grant you respite until an appointed term[1]. Indeed, when Allah’s appointed term comes, it cannot be delayed, if you only knew!”
4.footnotes: [1] i.e., until the time your life comes to an end.

5.translation: He said, “My Lord, I have surely called my people night and day,

6.translation: but my call only drove them further away.

7.translation: Every time I call them so that You may forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears and cover their faces with their garments[2], and persist in obstinacy and grow extremely arrogant.
7.footnotes: [2] Refusing to see me or listen to my call.

9.translation: then I addressed them in public and in private,

10.translation: I said, ‘Seek forgiveness from your Lord. Indeed, He is Most Forgiving.

11.translation: He will shower you with abundant rain from the sky,

12.translation: and He will give you wealth and children, and bestow upon you gardens and rivers.

13.translation: What is the matter with you that you do not fear the Majesty of Allah[3],

14.translation: when He has created you in stages[4]?
14.footnotes: [4] See 22:5 and 23:12-14 for the stages of the embryo.

15.translation: Do you not see how Allah has created seven heavens, one above another,

16.translation: and has placed the moon therein as a light and the sun as a burning lamp?

17.translation: Allah has produced you from the earth like a plant[5],
17.footnotes: [5] i.e., your father Adam, whom Allah created from clay.

18.translation: then He will return you into it and then will bring you out again.

19.translation: Allah has made the earth widespread for you

20.translation: so that you may tread its spacious paths[6].’”
20.footnotes: [6] In the pursuit of a lawful livelihood.

21.translation: Noah said, “My Lord, they have disobeyed me and followed those whose wealth and children did not increase them except in loss[7].
21.footnotes: [7] i.e., the lowly people among them followed their wealthy chiefs.

22.translation: They have contrived a mighty plot,

23.translation: They said, ‘Do not abandon your gods; and do not abandon Wadd, Suwā‘, Yaghūth, Ya‘ūq, and Nasr[8].’
23.footnotes: [8] These were the names of idols named after pious men of past generations before the time of Noah, to commemorate them. In later generations, people started worshiping these idols.

24.translation: They have led many astray. So [O Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error.”

25.translation: Because of their sins, they were drowned and then were cast into the Fire, and they did not find any helpers against Allah.

26.translation: Noah said, “My Lord, do not leave on earth a single disbeliever.

27.translation: For if You leave them, they will surely lead Your slaves astray and beget none but wicked disbelievers.

28.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents, and whoever enters my house as a believer, and all the believing men and women, and do not increase the wrongdoers except in ruin.”
